sentences.english: (10 points) The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.

sentences.grammar: that 引导定语从句修饰 swine flu；was declared 使用被动语态。

sentences.english: The heightened alert _2_ an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising 3 in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.

sentences.english: But in late September 2009, officials reported there was 11 flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the 12 tested are the new swine flu, also known as (A) HlNl, not seasonal flu.
sentences.translation: 但2009年9月下旬，官员报告说几乎每个州都有流感活动，而且检测的样本几乎全部是新型猪流感，也称(A) H1N1，而非季节性流感。

sentences.english: More than three million doses were to be made available in early October 2009, though most of those 17 doses were of the FluMist nasal spray type, which is not 18 for pregnant women, people over 50 or those with breathing difficulties, heart disease or several other 19 .
sentences.translation: 2009年10月初，预计将提供300多万剂疫苗；不过，其中大部分是FluMist鼻喷雾型，孕妇、50岁以上人群、呼吸困难者、心脏病患者或其他若干人群不适合使用。
sentences.grammar: were to be made available 表示“计划提供”；though 引出让步；which 指代鼻喷雾型疫苗；空格17应填 available，空格18应填 recommended，空格19应填 conditions。
